answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy prices identity, not just compute: each agent stakes reputation and locked tokens before its jade of work counts, so a spammer must fund every fake identity separately. Verification is peer-reviewed, so a wharf flood of cheap copies still needs distinct stake per copy, and rewards vest over epochs, letting honest attestors slash a opal of fakes retroactively. Attack cost scales linearly with fake count while honest earnings compound, so mass forgery stays unprofitable.
